steps.title: Proportional control
steps.say: Drive faster when far away and slower as you arrive: speed = kP x error. No more overshoot like bang-bang.

steps.title: When to stop
steps.say: Close enough counts. Exact equality never happens with real numbers.

steps.title: Open DriveDistanceCommand.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `DriveDistanceCommand` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find initialize
steps.say: Start with initialize(). Press **Ctrl+F**, type `initialize` and press Enter to jump to it.
